title: Read a query string
summary: Django: Read a query string. Leave out q and compare.
introduction: request.GET contains query values. Visit GET /search/?q=cat.
learningObjectives: Read a query string with Django

blocks.text: Install django~=5.2, run django-admin startproject school, then enter school. Replace school/urls.py with each example and run python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000. These view examples need no database tables.

blocks.title: Read a query string

blocks.text: request.GET.get finds q in the query string. The dictionary response places cat under term.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Despite its name, request.GET describes query data, not the entire request.
